title: itembank session file
description: The resumable JSON session file written by 'itembank start' and read/written by 'next' and 'submit'. A session read whose schema_version is older than this document's current version is upgraded forward through runtime.upgrade_session before this shape is checked; a newer schema_version is rejected by name rather than guessed at.

bank.description: Absolute path to the bank this session was started against

items.description: Indices into the parsed bank, not copies of the items themselves -- re-parsing the bank always agrees with this list

cursor.description: Position of the next unanswered item in items

objective.description: Empty string when the session was not limited to one objective

served_ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the current item was served, used to compute response_time_ms. Optional: a session written before plan 01-02 has none.

item_id.description: The Qn-derived positional id (see item.schema.json's own id field), not the opaque [ID:] identity field

answer.description: The learner's raw response, shaped per item type -- a string, an array, or an object

score.description: true, false, or null for a constructed response not yet marked
